author: Claude (independent verification track)
scope: Q2 / Area-A. Residual read entirely from the Round-80 archive: no frontier access, no continuation search, no revisiting of static slack-cover feasibility.

conservative_opening_relation.definition: q -> r iff there exist a phase f in {0..4}, a rotation-run length l in {0..5} and a non-rotation joint a in {w2:10,w3:120,w3:201,w3:210} with word_after(sigma^l(port(q,f)), a) a port of r
conservative_opening_relation.over_approximation_proof: a genuine opening of r from q is a macro edge from the walk's endpoint in q: l rotations then one joint landing in r. The engine imposes strictly more conditions -- every rotation target unvisited, the joint target unvisited, the child surviving area_a_prune_reason, and one specific endpoint phase. All are dropped here and the phase is existentially quantified over all five, which in particular permits arbitrary legal E^1 closure beforehand. Dropping conditions only adds edges.
conservative_opening_relation.exclusion_justification: an excluded (q,r) means r appears nowhere in the 120-element target multiset of q under the full macro generator set; this is exhaustion over the fixed group action, independent of visitation, resources and history
conservative_opening_relation.no_weight2_exclusion: a weight-2 joint into a fresh orbit is a legal engine transition -- extend() computes abandonment and new_orbit independently and gates neither -- so w2:10 stays in the joint set even though at l=5 it is the orbit-preserving E^1
conservative_opening_relation.cross_check: reproduces Round 75's 7,920 orbit-changing pairs and uniform out-degree 55 exactly

stage_B_first_open.reason: every residual state has at least 41 cover-compatible candidate orbits openable in one step from its currently-open set; the minimum over all 6,657 states is 71% of its candidates and the median is 96-98%

stage_C_iterated_reachability.reason: the reachable fixpoint contains EVERY cover-compatible candidate in all 6,657 states, so the restricted slack-cover instance is identical to the unrestricted one and was never re-decided

stage_D_joint_cover_reachability: NOT ATTEMPTED -- the payoff gate in the brief forbids spending computation once stages A-C close nothing, and with zero unreachable candidates the joint formulation is provably identical to Round 79's

negative_structural_result.statement: static incidence + orbit-level ordering is exhausted: every one of the 6,657 residual states admits a cover-compatible final orbit set that is entirely reachable under a maximally conservative opening relation
negative_structural_result.why: two independent reasons, both measured. (1) SLACK-COVER barely restricts individual orbit membership: the median state has 128 of 144 orbits cover-compatible, so the candidate family is nearly the whole orbit set even though the K-subsets it admits are heavily constrained. (2) the orbit-level relation has uniform out-degree 55 of 143, and the union over 7-10 open orbits reaches 71-100% of those candidates in a single step.
negative_structural_result.the_decisive_obstacle: phase. The phase-refined relation has uniform out-degree 17, not 55, and a walk pinned to one (orbit,phase) could open at most 17 candidates -- often as few as 5, and as few as 0 from the worst open phase. That is a factor of roughly 3.2 of unused restriction. It is unusable because E^1 moves the phase for free, so the conservative relation must quantify over all five phases.

what_finer_information_is_required: port-level occupancy / the no-repeat rule -- this is the single lever that would let phase be pinned, because it is exactly what gates E^1 (E^1 needs the current hexagon to hold only the endpoint and its target port unvisited). Charging E^1 is charging port occupancy.
which specific port of r an opening joint lands on, and whether that port is still unvisited
fragment repair: the unique doubly-passed hexagon must be re-entered at one specific window
resource timing -- deliberately not charged this round per the brief
do_not_do: no stronger exclusion was invented to manufacture payoff; every edge the relation omits is omitted by exhaustion over the fixed group action, not by absence from a search
disclaimer: This project has not proved L6 >= 872, and nothing here bears on that.
